name: vllm-safety-benchmark
description: A comprehensive safety evaluation suite for Vision LLMs (VLLMs) focusing on out-of-distribution generalization and adversarial robustness. It includes two novel VQA datasets with variants to test model performance under challenging conditions and evaluates the efficacy of jailbreaking strategies targeting vision or language components.
reputation: A recent safety benchmark for vision-language models that is cited for probing robustness and jailbreak resistance, but it is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Focuses on safety evaluation including OOD generalization and adversarial robustness for Vision LLMs; evaluates 21 models including GPT-4V.
